settings.title: Two prices, and you see both
settings.text: The Regular/Card Price and the lower Bank Payment Price are both shown for the exact piece you have configured, on the product page and in the cart, before you commit to anything. Neither is a promotion that expires.

settings.title: You see it before it ships
settings.text: Every piece is inspected before it leaves us. Renders are labelled as renders, photographs as photographs, and AI visualisations as AI visualisations, so what you are looking at is never in doubt.

settings.title: Somebody answers
settings.text: Email orders@caratforus.com and a person here replies. Returns, warranty claims and questions are handled by the same company that sold you the piece.

settings.title: It is covered
settings.text: One year, against manufacturing faults. Every outbound shipment is insured for its full value and tracked, and anything over $100 needs a signature — yours, not a doorstep.

settings.title: Five ways to buy, one standard
settings.text: Buy at today's price. Join a Group Buy and let the price fall as more people order. Have something made to your design. Take a Luxury Steal while it lasts. Or send us a quote you already hold and let us try to beat it. The inspection, the warranty and the people answering your email are the same whichever you choose.

Zelle and domestic wire both qualify. You see both prices before you commit, and nothing is charged when you choose bank payment: we show you where to send it, and your order is not confirmed until the funds arrive and we verify them.
